name: Megumi Oohara
bio:
Oohara Megumi is a voice actress (seiyuu) from Tokyo, Japan. She's 156cm tall and has type O blood. Her hobby is cooking and the appreaciation of music. She's a qualified beautician, and speaks English. Oohara is married and has a dog.

She has worked as a maid in a maid tavern.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam-Powered Time Machine
credits.overview: Nobita and his friends time-travel to 19th-century Victorian London.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
credits.overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Art World Tales
credits.overview: Nobita and Doraemon enter the world in a European Renaissance painting, but run into trouble as they hop from piece to piece in search of a malevolent time traveler who wishes to recreate the extinct pigment of "Artoria Blue".

credits.title: Doraemon: New Year Eve in Spain
credits.overview: Nobita falls asleep and Doraemon takes him to Spain to enjoy the grapes at Puerta del Sol, meeting a boy named Pedro and the soccer player Takefusa Kubo.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Sky Utopia
credits.overview: Doraemon, Nobita and his friends go to find Utopia, a perfect land in the sky where everyone lives with happiness, using an airship having a time warp function.

credits.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Little Star Wars 2021
credits.overview: During summer vacation Nobita picks up a small rocket containing Papi, a palm-sized alien president escaping rebels on his home planet Pirika.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita's New Dinosaur
credits.overview: Nobita accidentally finds a fossil dinosaur egg mixed with rocks in the dinosaur fossil exhibition site that he had visited before. He returns it to its original state with the 'time blanket'.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Treasure Island
credits.overview: Upon hearing about the story of Treasure Island, Nobita dreams of discovering and exploring his own treasure island, despite the fact all of the Earth has been mapped already.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the Antarctic Kachi Kochi
credits.overview: Doraemon and Nobita discover a mysterious golden ring far beneath the ice in Antarctica, leading them to uncover an ancient, ruined city.

credits.overview: Doraemon and his friends travel to ancient Japan where they meet Kukuru. When Kukuru tells them that his tribe has been enslaved by Gigazombie, Doraemon decides to help him.

credits.overview: Nobita and friends decide to make a movie inspired by the space adventures of their heroes, but their fiction turns into a reality.

credits.title: Stand by Me Doraemon
credits.overview: Sewashi and Doraemon find themselves way back in time and meet Nobita. It is up to Doraemon to take care of Nobita or else he will not return to the present.

credits.title: Doraemon: New Nobita's Great Demon - Peko and the Exploration Party of Five
credits.overview: Nobita is followed by a stray dog on his way home and decides to help it find its original owner with the help of Doraemon. They find out that the dog is actually a prince in its homeland in Africa.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Secret Gadget Museum
credits.overview: Doraemon and his friends travel to the 22nd century to look for his golden bell, which was stolen by a notorious thief called Kaito DX.

credits.title: ドラえもん誕生日スペシャル 「アリガトデスからの大脱走」
Doraemon: Nobita and the Island of Miracles – Animal Adventure
credits.overview: Nobita and Doraemon use time tree Mochi and catch a big bird, which has been extinct for 500 years ago. To protect the animal, Nobita and Doraemon go to Beremon Island, overseen by a golden beetle named Herakles.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the New Steel Troops: Winged Angels
credits.overview: Nobita and Doraemon find a giant robot in pieces which they later assemble. It turns out to be a destructive weapon and the gang must save Earth from an imminent invasion.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Battle of the Mermaid King
credits.overview: Nobita, Doraemon, and the rest must come to the aid of mermaid princess Sophia, whose undersea kingdom is suffering under the weight of a war. Their only hope lies in a mythical sword from the planet Aqua...

credits.title: Doraemon: The New Record of Nobita's Spaceblazer
credits.overview: Nobita finds a passage to a spaceship in another dimension. With their new friends, he and Doraemon fight the cruel leader of an exploited planet.

credits.title: ドラえもん誕生日スペシャル 「ドラえもんの青い涙」
Doraemon let's go: You can do with Dorami-chan
credits.overview: In accordance with the fun song and dance of Doraemon, to support the healthy growth of young children of the mind, body, intelligence, Shogakukan children magazine has produced this educational DVD series. In this work, go with the power to communicate while having fun dancing to the songs and rhythm.

credits.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Green Giant Legend
credits.overview: A sapling Nobita discovers is turned into a plant-boy with help from Doraemon, and becomes Earth's only hope at passing judgment from the dryadic aliens of the Green Planet.

credits.title: ドラえもん誕生日スペシャル 「ドラえもんが生まれ変わる日」
Doraemon: Nobita's New Great Adventure Into the Underworld - The Seven Magic Users
credits.overview: Nobita wishes the world into a magic-reliant one with Doraemon's Moshimo-Box, and, along with his friends, must stop an asteroid from hitting the planet with help from a sorcerer-in-training.

credits.title: ドラえもん誕生日スペシャル 「のび太くん、さようなら！ ドラえもん、未来へ帰る…」
Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur
credits.overview: After bringing a fossilized egg back to life with the Time Cloth, Nobita finds himself the owner of a baby dinosaur. Everything is fine until it grows up. Nobita and friends use Doraemon's time machine to return it back to its own time.

credits.title: ドラえもん誕生日スペシャル 「ご先祖さまがんばれ」
Youth Bakachin Cooking School
credits.overview: Hitomi Kogure, has decided to drop out of high school. Deciding to tell her e-mail penpal "Ayumi-chan", her online friend reveals she is joining a cooking class. In order to meet her friend, Hitomi decides to join as well. What happens when she realizes "Ayumi-chan" is not who Hitomi had in mind?
